Knowledge recorded by Shinnecock elders in 2014

Raccoons

The catalogue recalls raccoons in older food and material traditions and as foragers that drew attention to nuts and vegetation. It also describes a change by the time of compilation: raccoons were no longer being hunted for food in the account given.1

The proposed word “Ahrahoon?” carries a question mark in the original. That uncertainty is part of the record.1

Places named in the catalogue

Shinnecock territories.1

Page references

The Shinnecock Environmental Department compiled this catalogue from elders’ memories and community resource knowledge in 2014. Food and medicine appear here as historical knowledge; safe identification and treatment require current guidance.

Shinnecock Environmental Department, Natural Resources Identified by Shinnecock Elders, April 4, 2014, PDF p. 11. Page numbers count the cover as PDF page 1.
